name: J'orke
source:
J'orke – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
A mature massive om'verai with a sleek, serpentine form with brilliant golden scales that gleam like metal, wearing a short cloak. His eyes are blue and golden horns are tall & curved . A gray mane flows down his neck, and soft pink ear-fins add elegance. Dark stripes run along its tail, and sharp black claws rest calmly.
J'orke seems to be a hot-tempered om'verai, who can harm others without hestitation until stopped. He also seems to follow spiritsingers' rules without any kind of protest, including threatining his colleagues.
